comments.text: Whomever wants to parrot the old trope about communism being the sole source of Cuban misery, best you know that Puerto Rico, where I'm from, is almost as ruined as Cuba now, being a commonwealth of the United States of America, its economic influence and subject to its federal laws. Over 37 years I have seen how every time Puerto Rico prospers, members of Congress, a standing POTUS, hedge fund gangs or its own politicians find a way to bleed off the fruits of its labors, keeping the island in a constant state of relative struggle. The only reason that Cuba is worse off than Puerto Rico is that Cubans have given up their will to oppose their abusers, while Puerto Ricans are famous for fighting bad politics tooth and nail, sometimes violently.
